oauthExpired: That sign-in link expired. Click “Continue with Google” again.
oauthMismatch: Sign-in could not be verified. Start the Google flow again.
oauthMissingCode: Google did not return a sign-in code. Try the Google button again.
oauthExchangeFailed: We couldn’t reach Google. Try again in a moment.
oauthInvalidToken: Google returned an invalid identity token. Try signing in again.

oauthFallback: Google sign-in did not complete. Try again.
onboardingSubtitle: Choose the name and language WAKA should use with you.
profileNicknameNoSpacesHint: This is how WAKA addresses and shows you. Spaces are okay.
profilePublicHint: Your public handle controls the read-only page at waka.im/@handle.
profilePublicHandleHint: Used only for your public URL, like waka.im/@your-handle. Use 3–24 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores; no spaces.
profilePublicHandleInvalid: Use 3–24 letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores; no spaces.
profilePublicHandleRequired: Choose a public handle before enabling public sharing.
profilePublicPrivacyHint: When public profile is off, your /@handle page is not visible. Enabling public profile shares your display name and read-only public page; enabling top-of-mind sharing also shares selected top-of-mind notes. Saved inspirations and account actions stay signed-in only.
profileDeleteHint: This permanently deletes your account and saved data for the current user only. Type DELETE to confirm.
profileMemoriesHint: Each memory keeps its own captures, signals, and top of mind. Yours is the human one; an agent memory lets Claude remember its own work alongside you rather than inside your notes.
profileMemoryRemoveConfirm: Remove this memory and everything in it? Its captures, signals, and top of mind all go with it, and this cannot be undone.
profileMemoryNameRequired: Give the memory a name first.
profileMemoriesError: Your memories could not be loaded.
profileConnectionsHint: Machines currently signed in to this account, and which memory each one acts as. Ending a connection signs that machine out; it cannot be undone, but you can always sign in again.
profileConnectionEndConfirm: End this connection? That machine will be signed out.
profileConnectionEndCurrentConfirm: This is the device you are using. Ending it signs you out here. Continue?
profileConnectionsError: Your connections could not be loaded.
principlesEmpty: Principles are earned. The patterns that keep surviving your top of mind become the way you choose — the first usually takes about six weeks of history. You can also declare one now, in your own words; it stays marked as yours-but-undemonstrated until your captures back it up.
principlesRemoveConfirm: Remove this principle? Its citations stay on the signals; only the directive goes.
principlesError: Your principles could not be loaded.
roomsEmpty: A room is a wall a few of you keep. Members put up chosen signals — never the captures behind them — and the room reads them into one shared top of mind, changed only by proposal.
roomsAlreadyMember: You are already in that room.
roomsError: Your rooms could not be loaded.
roomStillReading: Still reading — the new version will be here on your next visit.
roomBoardEmpty: Nothing has been read here yet. Once a few signals are up, read the room.
roomSharedEmpty: No one has put a signal up yet.
roomBringPick: put up one of your signals…
roomBringEmpty: Nothing of yours is ready — signals appear once your captures repeat.
roomProposalSent: Proposed. It carries when one more member stands behind it.
roomProposeAddPlaceholder: propose a new note for this wall…
roomAccepted: Accepted — the room is being reread.
roomLeaveConfirm: Leave this room? Your shared signals come off its wall.
roomCloseConfirm: Close this room for everyone? The wall and its readings go; nobody's signals or captures are touched.
roomError: This room could not be loaded.
surfaceUnavailableBody: Something this screen needs never arrived — usually a dropped connection, sometimes a version that changed while you were here. Nothing you kept is affected.
